caption: The drawing depicts a single, prominent organic form resembling a branching structure or a stylized leaf, positioned vertically within a rectangular frame. The central object is composed of a series of small, rounded, closely packed dabs of color, primarily in shades of red, crimson, and orange, with a curving shape that loops at the bottom and tapers toward the top. Darker grayish-brown shapes form a central stem with several side branches extending symmetrically from it. The background is filled with densely packed small tan and light brown dots, creating a textured, mosaic-like effect, with a subtle gradient that transitions from lighter shades in the middle left and bottom to deeper brown hues on the right. There are no other objects present, and the drawing is bordered by an off-white margin with handwritten text at the bottom edge.
title: Hooked Rug (Section of Border)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
